content: Yesu Alisa Vantu Vavengi
Munima yevi Yesu uaile musinia lia Cisali ca Ngalileya, cije civatumbula naua nguavo Cisali ca Timbeliase.
Civunga cakama camukavele, omuo vamuene vitantekeyeso vije viakele nakulinga ku vaka kuvavala.
Yesu ualondele ku munkinda nakutumama hamo na vandongisi vendi.
Tele Paseka Ciuano ca Vayunda cakele muyehi.
Omo Yesu uanduile mesho endi uamuene civunga cakama cili nakuija kuli ikeye, nankuma uehuile Filipu nguendi, “Kuli tuasa kulanda viakulia via vantu ava linga valie?”
Uahandekele eci mukumueseka, omuo ikeye vavenia uatantekeyele vije viakalinga.
Filipu uamukumbuluile nguendi, “Cipue vihita vivali (200) via vimbongo via muuaya uaya kuviasa kulanda viakulia viakulisa ava linga umo na umo auane kakandende.”
Umo ua vandongisi vendi, Anduleo munaina ya Simoni Petulu, uahandekele kuli ikeye nguendi,
“Kuli kanike kayala kuno alina mikasha itanu ya mbolo na vantsi vavali. Vuno honi viasa kupuamo kuli vantu voshe ava ndi?”
Yesu uahandekele nguendi, “Lekeni vantu voshe vatumame ha mavu.” Kuakele muila uauingi ku cihela cije, nankuma voshe vatumamene ha mavu, kuakele vamala vakupua mu makulukazi atanu (5,000).
Kaha Yesu uatambuile ije mikasha ya mbolo, uatsatselelele kuli Njambi, kaha uaipangezelele vantu vaje vatumamene, ualingile cuma cimo naku vantsi naua, voshe valile kaha vakutile muva tondelelelemo.
Omo voshe vakutile, Yesu ualekele vandongisi vendi nguendi, “Kungululeni evi vimbazuvuila vinasalaho, keti tuvihiseho cipue tuatundende.”
Nankuma vavikunguluile vioshe, kuje ku vimbazuvuila via mikasha itanu ya mbolo ivasezele vaje valile, vashulisileho mitonga likumi na ivali.
Omo vantu vamuene vitantekeyeso vialingile Yesu, vaputukile kuhandeka nguavo, “Cilivene ou ikeye kananguizi ua Njambi uje akeja hano ha mavu.”
Omo Yesu uatantekeyele nguendi vatonda kumukuata linga vamupuise muene, uaile naua ku munkinda likaliendi lika.
Yesu Enda ha Mema
Omo litangua liatokele, vandongisi va Yesu vaile ku cisali,
vakovelele mu vuato nakuya musinia lia cisali ku Kapenauma. Kuaputukile milima, tele hanga Yesu kanda acihete kuli vakevo.
Cisali cakele nakulininganga omuo kuahitile mpunzi yakama.
Omo vajavuile ntunda ya mantambo akupua atatu cipue auana, vamuene Yesu alinakuenda ha mema kuija kuyehi na vuato, kaha vovuile liova.
Vuno honi Yesu uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi, “Yange vene, keti muvue liova.”
Kaha vatondele kumukovelesa mu vuato, hajevene vuato vuahetele ku ntunda kumutambela kuje vakele nakuya.
Vantu Vatonda Yesu

Liamukuavo civunga ca vantu vaje vasalele musinia lia cisali vamuene nguavo kuakele lika vuato vumolika kuje. Vamuene naua nguavo Yesu kakovelele hamo mu vuato na vandongisi vendi, vuno honi vandongisi vendi vaile lika likaliavo.
Kaha mato amo aje ahumine ku Timbeliase ezile kuyehi na cihela kuje kuvalililile mbolo hanima ya Muene kuitsatselela kuli Njambi.
Nankuma, omo civunga camuene ngeci Yesu na vandongisi vendi vahiko kuje, vakovelele mu mato nakuya ku Kapenauma mukutonda Yesu.
Yesu Ikeye Mbolo ya Muono
Omo vamuuanene musinia lia cisali, vahandekele kuli ikeye nguavo, “Mulongisi, tangua lika unezile kuno?”
Yesu uavakumbuluile nguendi, “Mua vusunga vene njimileka nguange, muli nakunjitonda, keti ngue omuo muamuene vitantekeyeso viange, vuno honi omuo mualile mbolo nakukuta.
Keti mupangele viakulia vije vikapola, vuno honi pangeleni viakulia via muono ua yaye, vije Muna Muntu akamihanavio. Omuo Njambi, Ishe namuhaka cimueso ca kumutava.”
Kaha vamuhuile nguavo, “Vika tuapande kulinga linga tulinge vije viatonda Njambi?”
Yesu uavakumbuluile nguendi, “Eci cinapu cipangi ca Njambi, linga mutsiliele muli uje yanatumu.”
Nankuma, vamuihuile nguavo, “Citantekeyeso muka ukatuhana honi, linga tukacimone na kukutsiliela? Cipangi muka ukalinga?
Vakukuluila vetu valile maana mu Mpambo, ngue muvanacisoneka nguavo, ‘Uavahanene mbolo yakuhuminina kuilu linga valie!’ ”
Kaha Yesu uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi, “Mua vusunga vene njimileka nguange, kapuile Mosesa uje uamihanene mbolo yakuhuma kuilu, vuno honi Tate ikeye akamihana mbolo ya vusunga ya kuhuma kuilu.
Omuo mbolo ya Njambi yapua ije ihuma muilu nakuhana muono kuli vaka mavu.”
Vahandekele kuli ikeye nguavo, “Muene, tuhane eyi mbolo ntsimbu yoshe.”
Yesu uavalekele nguendi, “Yange mbolo ya muono. Uoshe uje eja kuli yange kakatsiho njala, naua uoshe uje atsiliela kuli yange kakevuiho mpuila.
Vuno honi njamilekele nguange muanjimono vuno honi kumuasa kunjitsiliela.
Coshe cije canjihana Tate cija kuli yange, na uoshe uje eja kuli yange kunjikamusheke,
omuo njahumine muilu, keti ngue mukulinga cizango cange, vuno honi cizango cauje uanjitumine.
Honi eci cikeco cizango cauje uanjitumine, linga keti njikahone cimo ku vioshe vije viananjihana, vuno honi njikavasanguile ku muono ha litangua liama manusuilo.
Eci cilivene cikeco cizango ca Tate, ngeci uoshe amona Muana nakutsiliela kuli ikeye akakale na muono ua yaye, kaha njikamusanguile ku muono ha litangua liama manusuilo.”
Kaha vantuama va Vayunda vaputukile kuliniengetela hali ikeye omuo uahandekele nguendi, “Yange mbolo ije yahumine kuilu.”
Vakele nakuhandeka nguavo, “Keti ikeye Yesu ou, muna Yosefa, uje ishe na vaina vatutantekeya ndi? Cija vati ahandeke nguendi, ‘Njahumininine muilu’?”
Yesu uavakumbuluile nguendi, “Keti muliniengete hhakati keni.
Naumo uahi asa kuija kuli yange kuvanga uje yaneha Tate uanjitumine, kaha njikamusanguile ku muono uje muntu ha litangua liama manusuilo.
Vanacisoneka ku tunanguizi va Njambi va Njambi nguavo, ‘Voshe Njambi akavalongesa.’ Uoshe evua Tate nakulilongesa kuli ikeye eja kuli yange.
Keti nguavo muntu uoshe uamona Tate, vuno honi kuvanga lika uje uahuma kuli Njambi ikeye uamona Tate.
Mua vusunga vene njimileka nguange, uje uoshe atsiliela alina muono uayaye.
Yange mbolo ya muono.
Vakukuluila veni valile maana mu Mpambo na kutsa.
Eyi ikeyo mbolo ije ihuma muilu, linga uoshe uje aliako kakatsi.
Yange mbolo ya muono ije yahumine muilu. Uoshe uje alia ku mbolo eyi akayoya miaka yoshe, kaha mbolo ije injikahana ya muono ua vaka mavu inapu muvila uange.”
Vantuama va Vayunda vaputukile kulinga vimpata hhakati kavo, vahandekele nguavo, “Cija vati ou yala atuhane muvila uendi linga tu ulie?”
Nankuma, Yesu uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi, “Mua vusunga vene njimileka nguange, nga kumukali muvila ua Muna Muntu na kunua maninga endi, kaha kumukakala na muono.
Voshe valia muvila uange na kunua maninga ange valina muono uayaye, kaha njikavasanguila ku muono ha litangua liama manusuilo,
omuo muvila uange ukeuo viakulia via vusunga na maninga ange akeuo viakunua via vusunga.
Vaje voshe valia muvila uange na kunua maninga ange vakala muli yange, nange njikala muli vakevo.
Ngue muanjitumine Tate uakuyoya, nange njilinakuyoya omuo Tate, nankuma uoshe akanjilia akayoya omuo yange.
Eyi ikeyo mbolo ije yahumine muilu, keti ngue ije ivalile vakukuluila veni, kaha vatsile. Vuno honi uoshe uje alia mbolo eyi akayoya miaka yoshe.”
Yesu uakele nakuhandeka evi oku tele ali nakulongesa mu njivo ya malombelo ku Kapenauma.
Mezi a Muono Uayaye
Omo vandongisi vendi vavengi vovuile evi, vahandekele nguavo, “Vilongesa evi viavikalu, iya asa kuvitambula?”
Vuno honi Yesu hakutantekeya ngeci vandongisi vendi vali nakuliniengetela ha cikeco, uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi, “Nkuma eci cilinakumivuisa kupihia ndi?
Kaha vatihoni nga muamuene Muna Muntu alonda kuya kuakele ha kulivanga?
Cimbembesi ua Njambi ikeye akahana muono, muvilani uapua uangoco. Mezi aua anjinahandeka kuli yeni akeuo a Cimbembesi na muono.
Vuno honi hhakati keni kuli vamo vaje vakuhona kutsiliela.” Omuo Yesu uatantekeyele laja hume hambangelo vaje vaka kuhona kutsiliela, na vaje vaka muenda vungungu.
Nankuma, uahandekele nguendi, “Ha cuma eci njamilekele nguange naumo uahi asa kuija kuli yange kuvanga Tate amutavese.”
Omuo yevi vilongesa, vandongisi vendi vavengi vahilukilemo nakuhona naua kumukavangeya.
Nankuma Yesu uehuile vandongisi vendi likumi na vavali nguendi, “Neni naua mutonda kuhilukamo ndi?”
Simoni Petulu uamukumbuluile nguendi, “Muene, kuli iya tuasa kuya? Yove uli na mezi a muono ua yaye.
Tuatsiliela honi nakutantekeya nguetu yove uapua Umo Uakulela ua Njambi.”
Yesu uavakumbuluile nguendi, “Nkuma keti yange njamihanguile, yeni vandongisi likumi na vavali ndi? Vuno honi umo ueni napu satana.”
Uakele nakuhandeka Yundasa muna Simoni Sakaliote, cipue vene uapuile umo uavaje vandongisi likumi na vavali, ikeye akamuenda vungungu.
